findings.description: The hop set unions the client list, but the re-add tests h[content-length] rather than the strip set, so deleting content-length cannot remove the re-added header. The four semantic names are deletable and observable (304 to 200, 206 to 200).
findings.title: Client-nominated deletion works on non-framing headers; Content-Length survives because the re-add gates on the client's own map

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
